metadata.name: tenzro_cross_vm
metadata.description: Canonical SVM-side program for initiating cross-VM token transfers from Solana-flavored transactions into the Tenzro EVM cross_vm_bridge precompile at 0x1003. Native program: no stored ELF, dispatched directly by the SVM executor.
metadata.consensus_authority: EVM precompile 0x1003 (cross_vm_bridge) — this program emits a structured Log; the actual cross-VM balance transition is consensus-mediated by the EVM-side handler.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Transaction signer; balance is debited for gas (in lamport-equivalent compute units).

args.name: mint
docs: SPL mint Pubkey for the token being bridged.

args.name: evm_dest
docs: EVM-side recipient (20-byte address).

args.name: amount
docs: Amount in SPL native units (mint decimals).

args.name: nonce
docs: Replay-protection nonce; must be strictly increasing per (mint, sender) pair.

errors.name: InvalidDestVm

errors.name: ValueMustBeZero
